protocol.transport: gloo over shared memory, one host
protocol.grid_construction: log-spaced backbone rounded to 4-byte words, NOT restricted to powers of two, plus oversampling in four named regions

oversampled_regions.name: latency_to_bandwidth
oversampled_regions.why: where the latency floor gives way to a bandwidth slope

oversampled_regions.name: cache_peak
oversampled_regions.why: where effective bandwidth peaked in the previous campaign, consistent with the buffer still fitting in cache

oversampled_regions.name: peak_decline
oversampled_regions.why: where bandwidth fell again past the peak

oversampled_regions.name: prior_breakpoints
oversampled_regions.why: where the earlier two-segment fits placed their breakpoints

protocol.pass_purpose: two independent passes so the bandwidth peak's location, magnitude and regime ordering can be compared; a peak seen once is not a property of the transport
protocol.cross_validation: stratified k-fold over message size, folds assigned round-robin within each regime so no fold can be missing a regime

acceptance.why_not_pooled: a pooled median lets one useless regime hide behind three good ones, which is how a model 35% wrong in the medium tier was previously accepted

a_regime_is_covered_when: it was measured with at least min_points_per_regime valid points
held-out validation graded the model in that regime
the regime's cross-validated error is within the threshold
measurement noise in that regime is within max_noise_cv

protocol.subsystem_readiness: conjunctive: every required group covered, every required regime covered, accepted models only, held-out validation present in every cell. There is no arithmetic that trades a covered group against a missing one.
protocol.transferability: NOTHING measured here is a value for NVLink or InfiniBand. This is gloo over shared memory on one host. What the campaign can establish is methodology readiness -- that the grid, the estimators, the selection rule and the coverage criteria work -- not fabric parameters for an A100 node.

all_gather/world2.reason: The best family, `piecewise/weighted`, still misses its worst-fitting regime by 33% (gate: 15%). No family here describes this transport, so none is promoted; all remain diagnostic. Widening the gate to admit one would be choosing the answer.

all_gather/world3.reason: `piecewise/huber` wins on worst-tier held-out error (13.4%) against `regime/huber` 13.4%, `piecewise/weighted` 13.4%. The decision is held-out error, not fit quality: a more flexible family always fits its own data better.

all_gather/world4.reason: `piecewise/log` is within 10% of `regime/log` on worst-regime held-out error (14.0% against 13.5%) with fewer parameters, so the simpler family is preferred.

all_reduce/world2.reason: The best family, `regime/log`, still misses its worst-fitting regime by 37% (gate: 15%). No family here describes this transport, so none is promoted; all remain diagnostic. Widening the gate to admit one would be choosing the answer.

all_reduce/world3.reason: The best family, `regime/log`, still misses its worst-fitting regime by 24% (gate: 15%). No family here describes this transport, so none is promoted; all remain diagnostic. Widening the gate to admit one would be choosing the answer. Note that run-to-run variation on this group is 37.3%, so the residual is close to the measurement noise: a better model family would not fix it, and a cleaner measurement might. That is a statement about the instrument, not about the model.

predictions.name: recampaign-higher-replicates-v1
predictions.question: Does the communication surface become gradable when it is measured at the replicate count the noise budget requires, rather than at the two the original campaign carried?

design.rationale: The launch-level noise floor is 12.3% and the gate is 15%, so the gate is reachable inside one launch. Repeats are bought rather than launches because a launch pays transport setup for every probe it carries.

predictions.claim: The median recorded per-record CV rises from 0.058 to about 0.107, because a CV from two samples understates dispersion by 1.83x.
predictions.falsified_if: the median recorded CV stays within 20% of its old value, which would mean the two-sample bias correction is wrong and every cell it reclassified must be reclassified back

predictions.claim: Coverage rises above 8 of 24 cells, because thirteen of the sixteen uncovered cells were classified as limited by measurement rather than by the model.
predictions.falsified_if: coverage does not improve, which would mean the residuals were never the instrument's and the noise-limited classification is wrong

predictions.claim: all_gather/world2 small, all_reduce/world4 tiny and all_reduce/world4 medium stay uncovered, because their residuals are already well above their measurement noise and more repeats cannot close a gap the instrument did not open.
predictions.falsified_if: any of the three becomes covered, which would mean the model-limited classification was itself a noise artefact

predictions.not_predicted: Nothing here predicts that six of six groups will pass. The point is to find out which of the three diagnoses -- noise, model, instrument -- was right about each cell, and a result in which coverage improves only a little is as informative as one in which it improves a lot.
